source.publication: 2025 PIT-RES Resident Individual Income Tax Return Instructions and Form PIT-RES 2025; tax rate schedule from 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14)
source.section: Form PIT-RES Lines 1-12, 20a-24, 26-27b, 32-33; Instructions PDF p.5 Line 1; PDF p.8 Line 20a standard deduction table, Line 24, Line 27a; PDF p.9 Line 27b; tax rate schedule 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14) (record brackets cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 45,250.00 = 45,250.00. Federal taxable income = 45,250.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 29,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form PIT-RES (filing status 1 single, Column B): Line 1 federal AGI 45,250.00; Line 2 other states' obligations interest 0.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 4 total 45,250.00. Line 5 U.S. obligations interest 0.00. Line 6 pension exclusion 0.00. Line 7 0.00; Line 8a 0.00; Line 8b 0.00. Line 9 (Lines 5-8b) = 0.00. Line 10 = 45,250.00 - 0.00 = 45,250.00. Line 11 0.00 (Line 11 worksheet: earned income is 2,500 or more, so no). Line 12 Delaware AGI = 45,250.00. Line 20a standard deduction (filing status 1) 3,250.00; Line 21 additional standard deduction 0 box(es) for 65 or over x 2,500.00 = 0.00; Line 22 = 3,250.00. Line 23 taxable income = 45,250.00 - 3,250.00 = 42,000.00. Line 24 tax, §1102(a)(14) schedule as numbers: 2.2% x 3,000.00 = 66.00 + 3.9% x 5,000.00 = 195.00 + 4.8% x 10,000.00 = 480.00 + 5.2% x 5,000.00 = 260.00 + 5.55% x 17,000.00 = 943.50; total 1,944.50 (the Division's tax table, not in the sources, would give a row figure; expected keeps the formula). Line 25 0.00; Line 26 = 1,944.50. Line 27a personal credits 1 x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 27b additional credits 1 box(es) for 60 or over x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 32 total non-refundable credits 220.00. Line 33 balance = 1,944.50 - 220.00 = 1,724.50. Age 60 on December 31, 2025 (born 1965-12-31) counts as 60 or over for Line 27b.
